### 1. Locally on PC/Mac (Free)
Run n8n on your local machine using npm or Docker:
* **npm (Requires Node.js)**:

  npm install n8n -g
  n8n start

  docker run -it --rm --name n8n -p 5678:5678 n8n/n8n

* Access the interface locally at `http://127.0.0.1:5678`.
